conventions.prior: theta ~ N(mu, sigma); sigma is inputs.sigma when a case has one, else the top-level sigma
conventions.log_posterior: sum_j log p(y_j | theta) + log N(theta; mu, sigma), all normalising constants included (gaussian terms include -log(sigma) - log(2 pi)/2)

map.step: candidates in order: Newton H = sigma^-1 + diag(observed information) if its Cholesky succeeds, then Fisher H = sigma^-1 + diag(expected information); step = H^-1 g; take the first candidate whose halving search passes; if none passes, stop without moving
map.halving_test: s = 1, 1/2, ... (at most max_halvings halvings) until lp(theta + s step) >= lp(theta) - lp_slack * (1 + |lp(theta)|)

observed_information.3pl: y = 0: a^2 s (1 - s); y = 1: a^2 u (1 - s) (s (u + 2c) - c) / P^2, with s = logistic(a (theta - b)), u = (1 - c) s, P = c + u
observed_information.grm: a^2 (v_y + v_{y+1}) with v_j = s_j (1 - s_j), s_j = logistic(a (theta - b_j)) for j = 1..m, v_0 = v_{m+1} = 0

map.stop: after an accepted step with max|s * step| < tol, or max_iter
map.n_iter: iterations run (1 when there are no observations); informational, not held to the tolerance

conventions.cov: inverse of (sigma^-1 + diag(total expected information at theta_map))

eap.weights: equal: w_i = exp(logpost_i - max_i logpost_i), normalised

conventions.nearest_pd: symmetrise; clip eigenvalues below floor up to floor (if min < floor - 1e-12); rescale to unit diagonal; if the min eigenvalue lam is still < floor - 1e-12, C = (1 - t) C + t I with t = (floor - lam) / (1 - lam)

nearest_pd.description: The initial Sigma: already PD above the floor, returned unchanged.
Clipping, then the shrink toward I restores the floor.

Non-unit diagonal: rescaled to a correlation matrix.
